title: Base change commutes with one inclusion of opens
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Work in the unbounded derived categories of modules [def-pc-derived-category], with K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), and φ:L(g′)K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For opens W⊆U⊆X, let αW and αU be the local arrows of [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Let r: R(f|U)_*(K|U)→R(f|W)_*(K|W) be its canonical relative restriction, and let r′ be the analogous restriction for the inverse-image opens, expressed using the canonical pullback lift. Then Lg*(r) followed by αW equals αU followed by r′. No covering, quasi-coherence or compactness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Prove naturality of relativeMVRestriction in the coefficient object for any factorization k≫j=l: transpose its middle factor and use naturality of the counit and pullback comparisons; move the direct-image comparison maps by naturality. This is the proved private helper restriction_coefficients.

Use the source and target counit-normal-form statements with identity coefficients. Their right sides coincide definitionally, so transitivity and injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence give the geometric square. Factor each arbitrary-coefficient local arrow and use the proved restriction_coefficients to move φ through the target restriction. Associativity finishes.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_restriction_naturality
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (W U : X.Opens) (i : W ≤ U) :
    (derivedPullback g).map
        (relativeMVRestriction (X.homOfLE i) U.ι W.ι (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X i) f K) ≫
      (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ W).hom =
      (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ U).hom ≫
        relativeMVRestriction (relativeMVOpenLift g' i) (pullback.fst g' U.ι)
          (pullback.fst g' W.ι) (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) f' K'
